title: 第12章 万卡阁
novel_title: 穿越源卡大陆，我自带融合卡牌
content_zh:
“喵呜~”

    “喵呜！”

    林峰清理完伤口，又换了身衣服才回家。可他刚走到家门口，就听见屋里传来此起彼伏的猫叫声，那调子一听就是林奇的声音。

    “儿子，你这是干嘛呢？”

    只见林奇正蹲在桌子旁，凑着风铃猫的耳朵，一脸认真地学猫叫，而风铃猫也歪着脑袋，尾巴上的铃铛虚影轻轻晃动，像是在指导他发音。

    “哦，我这是在促进和风铃猫的感情。

    书上说，御卡师和卡兽之间的羁绊越高，卡兽的实力就能发挥得越强，甚至最后能达到心灵相通的境界，到时候它不用我指挥，就能知道我想干什么。”

    林峰一边系围裙准备做饭，一边撇了撇嘴。

    “别听书上瞎说，那些都是骗小孩子的。

    御兽是最浪费时间的事情。

    你想啊，御卡师辛辛苦苦照顾卡兽，每天要喂特制的饲料，还得陪它玩、帮它梳理毛发，浪费精力不说，还得省吃俭用攒钱买资源。

    真到了打架的时候，又不敢让卡兽冲在前面，生怕被人打死。卡兽一死，这张御兽卡就废了，之前的投入全打水漂。”

    林奇无奈地摇了摇头，站起身，顺手摸了摸风铃猫的脑袋，猫咪舒服地蹭了蹭他的手心。

    “爹，你不要拿你们佣兵团的人来说事。他们顶天了就是绿色品质的卡兽，根本就没成长起来。

    我从书上看到，以前有个御卡师的卡兽是巨龙，他直接化身龙骑士，同等境界的御卡师有多少他打多少，直接是同阶无敌啊！”

    “巨龙怎么了？”

    林峰不服气地反驳，手里的菜刀“咚咚”地剁着肉。

    “我们器具卡也出过厉害人物！当年有个剑圣，本命卡是一把斩龙剑，人送外号斩龙骑士，专门斩巨龙，厉害得很！”

    林奇看着老爹较真的样子，忍不住笑了。

    “好好好，器具卡厉害。不过老爹你说的也对，厉害的卡兽确实不是我们这种普通家庭能养得起的。要是真给我一头巨龙，就算把整个石铁城掏空了，也不够它吃几顿的，还是召唤卡实在。”

    父子俩拌嘴的功夫，林峰已经麻利地做好了饭，端上来六菜一汤，有炒的风干卡兽肉，有炖的骨头汤，还有新鲜的青菜，香气扑鼻。

    林奇拿起筷子，刚吃了两口，就想起了正事。

    “爹啊，吃完饭我想去万卡阁买点尘星卡。”

    “尘星卡？”

    林峰夹菜的手顿了一下，一脸疑惑地看着他。

    “你买那玩意儿干嘛？尘星卡基本都是些没用的废卡，你现在突破一星卡徒了，就算买卡，也得买二星卡啊。”

    “呃……”

    林奇想了想，觉得现在还是不给他说太多比较好。

    “哦，就是随便看看，要是有合适的卡牌，就买一张试试水，熟悉熟悉卡牌种类。”

    林峰没多想，点了点头：“行，你从小就有主见，做事有分寸。现在你也是一星卡徒了，过段时间要是御卡学院招生，你就去试试，能进学院系统学本事，比在家瞎琢磨强。至于家里的商店，有我和你瑞廉叔看着，肯定能做大做强！”

    “别别别，老爹你维持现状就行，可千万别擅自发挥。”

    林奇连忙摆手制止。

    当初他可是好不容易，一把屎一把尿的把林峰从一个经商头脑约等于0的白痴教导成现在可以独当一面。
content_en:
"Meow~"

    "Meow!"

    Lin Feng cleaned the wound and changed his clothes before going home. But as soon as he walked to the door of his house, he heard cats meowing one after another from inside the house, and the tune sounded like Lynch's voice.

    "Son, what are you doing?"

    I saw Lin Qi squatting next to the table, leaning against the ears of the wind chime cat, imitating the cat's meow with a serious look on his face. The wind chime cat also tilted its head, and the shadow of the bell on its tail swayed slightly, as if to guide him in pronunciation.

    "Oh, I'm promoting my relationship with Wind Chime Cat.

    The book says that the higher the bond between the card master and the card beast, the stronger the card beast will be, and it will even reach the state of spiritual communication. At that time, it will know what I want to do without my command. "

    Lin Feng curled his lips while putting on his apron and getting ready to cook.

    "Don't listen to the nonsense in the books, they are all lies to children.

    Controlling animals is the biggest waste of time.

    Think about it, the card master works hard to take care of the card beast. He has to feed it special feed every day, play with it, and groom it. Not to mention wasting energy, he also has to save money to buy resources.

    When it came time to fight, I didn't dare to let the card beast rush in front for fear of being beaten to death. Once the card beast dies, this beast control card will be useless, and all the previous investment will be in vain. "

    Lin Qi shook his head helplessly, stood up, and touched the head of the wind chime cat. The cat rubbed his palm comfortably.

    "Dad, don't take the people of your mercenary group for granted. They are just green-quality beasts, and they haven't grown up at all.

    I read from the book that there used to be a card master whose card beast was a giant dragon. He transformed directly into a dragon knight. He could defeat as many card masters of the same level as he could. He was directly invincible at the same level! "

    "What happened to the dragon?"

    Lin Feng retorted unconvinced, chopping the meat with the kitchen knife in his hand.

    "We also have powerful characters in our equipment cards! There was a sword master back then. His life card was a dragon-slaying sword. He was nicknamed the Dragon-Slaying Knight. He specialized in slaying giant dragons. He was very powerful!"

    Lin Qi couldn't help but smile when he saw his father's serious look.

    "Okay, okay, the equipment card is powerful. But you are right, dad. A powerful card beast is indeed not something that ordinary families like us can afford. If I were given a giant dragon, even if I emptied the entire Stone Iron City, it would not be enough for it to eat a few meals. The summon card is still strong."

    While the father and son were bickering, Lin Feng had already cooked the rice quickly and served six dishes and one soup, including fried air-dried pork, stewed bone soup, and fresh vegetables, which were fragrant.

    Lin Qi picked up the chopsticks and took just two bites when he thought of business.

    "Dad, after dinner, I want to go to Wanka Pavilion to buy some Dust Star Cards."

    "Dust Star Card?"

    Lin Feng's hand holding the vegetables paused and he looked at him with confusion.

    "Why did you buy that thing? Dust star cards are basically useless cards. Now that you have broken through the one-star card apprentice, even if you buy a card, you still have to buy a two-star card."

    "Uh..."

    Lin Qi thought for a while and felt that it would be better not to tell him too much now.

    "Oh, just take a look around. If there is a suitable card, buy one to try the water and get familiar with the card types."

    Lin Feng didn't think much and nodded: "Okay, you have been independent since you were a child and have a sense of what you do. Now you are also a one-star card apprentice. If the Royal Card Academy recruits students in a while, you can try it. It is better to enter the academy system to learn skills than to study at home. As for the store at home, with me and your Uncle Rui Lian watching over it, it will definitely become bigger and stronger!"

    "No, no, no, dad, just maintain the status quo, but don't act on your own."

    Lin Qi quickly waved his hand to stop him.

    He had a hard time teaching Lin Feng from an idiot with almost zero business acumen to now being able to take charge of his own business.
